title: New Clues Change the Picture of T. Rex
summary:
Scientists keep learning new things about Tyrannosaurus rex. Early pictures showed a slow swamp dinosaur with a dragging tail. Newer ideas show a more active animal that may have been warm-blooded and possibly had feathers.

Its tiny arms were a long puzzle. Fossils show T. rex had two fingers. A study says small arms left room for a huge, strong head and neck muscles.

Some research says lips may have covered its teeth when its mouth was closed. That is different from many movie pictures with teeth always showing.

T. rex was probably not a fast long-distance runner. Estimates put its top speed near 12 miles per hour. It may have used short bursts to hunt and also eaten large dead animals. Scientists still study how much food it needed.
why_it_matters: Dinosaur updates show that science keeps improving old pictures with better evidence.
